title: Tariff Entry: Charges Arising on Unpaid Rent for Safe Deposit Boxes
content:
Where a year's rent on Safe Deposit Boxes is unpaid after the grace period, a late fee falls due. The fee is set by box size; the grace period is not.

| Size | Late fee | Grace period after the rent due date | Courtesy late fee waivers per customer in a rolling 365 days |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 3x5 Safe Deposit Box | $15.00 | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| 3x10 Safe Deposit Box | $15.00 | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| 5x10 Safe Deposit Box | $20.00 | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| 10x10 Safe Deposit Box | $25.00 | 30 calendar days | 1 |
| 10x15 Safe Deposit Box | $25.00 | 30 calendar days | 2 |
| 10x20 Safe Deposit Box | $30.00 | 30 calendar days | 2 |

**Grace period.** For every size the grace period is 30 calendar days after the rent due date. It is the period after which the late fee applies and the rental becomes past due.

**Vault entry while the rental is not current.** For every size, entry to the vault is refused while the rental stands past due or pending drilling.

**Reading the tariff across the sizes.** The late fee takes four values over the six sizes: $15.00 on the two smallest, $20.00 on the 5x10 Safe Deposit Box, $25.00 on the 10x10 and 10x15 Safe Deposit Boxes, and $30.00 on the 10x20 Safe Deposit Box. The courtesy waiver allowance takes two values: one waiver in a rolling 365 days on the four smallest sizes, and two on the 10x15 and 10x20 Safe Deposit Boxes. The waiver allowance is counted per customer over a rolling 365 days, not per rental and not per calendar year.
